newsitem.title: UK: Legal & General up as bid spotlight shifts.
newsitem.headline: Legal & General up as bid spotlight shifts.

text.p: Shares in Legal & General Group broke to a new high on Friday as traders said the sector spotlight had shifted to L&G after news that LLoyds TSB will buy the remaining stock in Lloyds Abbey Life.
"I'm told there is speculation in the market that there could be a bid approach for the (L&G) stock," said one trader.
"I have not heard any names -- it is pure speculation."
L&G shares topped their previous high of 762p, setting a new record at 783. By 1112 GMT they were up 24 at 780p.
"I presume its on the back of the Lloyds Abbey Life deal," said another trader. "I haven't heard anything else."
Lloyds TSB earlier ended months of speculation in the sector saying it would buy the remaining shares of life insurer Lloyds Abbey Life. The terms valued Lloyds Abbey stock at 635p.
One analyst at Swiss bank in London said L&G shares were benefiting from a reassessment of where money should be going within the sector.
"(Legal & General) stock is good value at the moment," he said.
